notes.title: Position Fix
notes.notes:
In todays update, we have hopefully fixed the game position for Vive headsets.

Please let us know if there are any issues.

Also its important to get hte best experience you should be in the Vive optimal position ie in the blue circle.

Many Thanks

notes.title: Update 01/11
notes.notes:
Not much in this update i am afraid, removed Halloween lighting and witch, made a few changes for performance and hopefully getting closer the issue that causes some users to be too high throughout the experience.

There will be an update incoming soon with more content, we will keep everyone posted when near to releasing.

Cheers!

notes.title: Update 31/10 Halloween
notes.notes:
Few little changes including lighting now turned to a green tint.

New sequence added and a couple of subtle changes.

As per every update we are working to add a control option.

In addition the touch and Vive controller implemtation will be a while for obvious reasons it is a slow process! but will come in future releases.

Many Thanks and Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Build EA3 23/10
notes.notes:
Today we have released an update containing more content and more decoration.

We have also started to add the code for movement which is moving along nicely.

Any bugs or problems please let us know is the forums.

Also please do not forget to leave us a review good or bad it will only help us improve the experience.

notes.title: Update 23/10
notes.notes:
EA3 Build.

More content added along with conding started for movement mechanics.

notes.title: Update 18/10 EA2 Fix
notes.notes:
Due to some confusion we have now added keyboard shortcuts to start the game, you can now use the A key and B key as well as the xbox controller.

Many Thanks for purchasing our game!
